acquisition_delay_use: algebraic uniform shifts only; no additional measured repeats and no claim these are observed network/finality delays
controls: Same measured source bytes, full-window config, and accepted semantic decisions. Repetition variation includes shared-host scheduling; OS cache is preflight-warmed and uncontrolled.
cpu_affinity_rule: smallest CPU in original process allowed affinity set; single CPU for every worker
execution_order: five balanced repetition blocks with seeded randomized order of six cells, then one separately shuffled set of24 memory prefixes
memory_scope: 24 independent fresh processes; nested prefixes; one descriptive probe each; RSS before serialization and compact checkpoint bytes after; no repeated statistical memory inference.
scope: Cached local JSONL stream; six measured stages; aggregate immutable core; buffered local gzip output. No network, ABI semantics, learned model, durable notification, live arrival or operator response.
